Record Class SmartTagModels.SmartTagRow

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.doctor.history.SmartTagModels.SmartTagRow
Record Components:
historyId - stable Allure history id
name - display name
fullName - full name when known
primaryTag - highest-priority tag, or blank when none apply
tags - all applicable tags (never invents Flaky from insufficient history)
launchCount - launches considered in the window
transitionCount - pass↔fail flips; null when unknown/insufficient
durationAnomaly - whether the newest duration is anomalous (only when timings exist)
newestStatus - newest launch status
previousStatus - previous launch status when known, else blank
Enclosing class:
SmartTagModels
public static record SmartTagModels.SmartTagRow(String historyId, String name, String fullName, String primaryTag, List<String> tags, int launchCount, Integer transitionCount, boolean durationAnomaly, String newestStatus, String previousStatus) extends Record
One test's smart tags derived from cross-run history.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
